name: Question 3
problem:
Let $R=[-2,2]\times [8,10]$ be a region in the $xy$-plane, and let $P$ be a partition of $R,$ where

$$
\begin{aligned}{P}_{1}={{x}_{0},{x}_{1},…,{x}_{m}},\,{P}_{2}={{y}_{0},{y}_{1},…,{y}_{n}},\,P={P}_{1}\times {P}_{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Calculate the double integral

$$
{∬}_{R}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A,
$$

where $f$ is a function such that ${m}_{ij}={M}_{ij}=-1$ for all partitions $P$ of $R,$ and ${m}_{ij}$ and ${M}_{ij}$ are the minimum and maximum values of $f$ respectively in each subregion ${R}_{ij}.$
worked_solution:
For a function $f(x,y),$ the double integral of $f$ over a rectangular region $R$ is the unique number $I$ (if it exists) such that

$$
L(f,P)\le I\le U(f,P),
$$

over all partitions $P$ of $R,$ where the lower and upper sums respectively are given by

$$
\begin{aligned}L(f,P) & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}{m}_{ij}Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j} \\ U(f,P) & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}{M}_{ij}Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j}\end{aligned}
$$

and ${m}_{ij}$ and ${M}_{ij}$ are the minimum and maximum values of $f$ in each subregion ${R}_{ij}.$ 

Now, since ${m}_{ij}={M}_{ij}=-1,$ we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}L(f,P)=U(f,P) & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}(-1)\,Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j} \\  & =-1({\sum }_{i=1}^{m}Δ{x}_{i})({\sum }_{j=1}^{n}Δ{y}_{j}) \\  & =-1(2-(-2))(10-8) \\  & =-1\cdot 4\cdot 2 \\  & =-8.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we obtain

$$
L(f,P)=-8\le {∬}_{R}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A\le -8=U(f,P)
$$

which implies that

$$
{∬}_{R}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A=-8.
$$

Question 3
?

Let R=[−2,2]×[8,10] be a region in the xy-plane, and let P be a partition of R, where

P1={x0,x1,…,xm},P2={y0,y1,…,yn},P=P1×P2.

Calculate the double integral ∬Rf(x,y)dA, where f is a function such that mij=Mij=−1 for all partitions P of R, and mij and Mij are the minimum and maximum values of f respectively in each subregion Rij.

a
−4
b
−2
c
8
d
−6
e
−8
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

For a function f(x,y), the double integral of f over a rectangular region R is the unique number I (if it exists) such that

L(f,P)≤I≤U(f,P),

over all partitions P of R, where the lower and upper sums respectively are given by

L(f,P)=∑i=1m∑j=1nmijΔxiΔyjU(f,P)=∑i=1m∑j=1nMijΔxiΔyj

and mij and Mij are the minimum and maximum values of f in each subregion Rij.

Now, since mij=Mij=−1, we obtain

L(f,P)=U(f,P)=∑i=1m∑j=1n(−1)ΔxiΔyj=−1(∑i=1mΔxi)(∑j=1nΔyj)=−1(2−(−2))(10−8)=−1⋅4⋅2=−8.

Finally, we obtain

L(f,P)=−8≤∬Rf(x,y)dA≤−8=U(f,P) which implies that

∬Rf(x,y)dA=−8.
